name: Selena
source:
[url=/c171507]Mara[/url]’s right hand gal, she is the most promising priestess in the Church of [url=/c171800]Luminox[/url] right now. Selena spends most of her time assisting Mara with whatever it is she may need. She enjoys spending her free time in the Cathedral’s garden, where she has helped with planting the vast majority of the flowers there. Rumors have it that her duties go as far as attending Bishop Mara at night.

[In game description]
